# GitHub workflow instructions

- Follow root `AGENTS.md` and [the workflow contract](../docs/repository-workflow-contract.md).
- Connect every new PR validation job to `ci-result` through its `needs` list and its `job_outputs` table. Keep `ci-result` running after dependency failures and cancellations so it reports the aggregate result.
- Use the `changes` job outputs to select affected validation. Update the planner inputs when shared validation dependencies change, and include `changes` in `ci-result.needs`.
- Manual validation uses the selected revision comparison. Do not add a full manual mode.
- Set `timeout-minutes` on every job. Follow [the workflow contract](../docs/repository-workflow-contract.md#validation) for the limits.
- Keep every workflow and local action free of actionlint and zizmor findings. After a change, run `go run github.com/rhysd/actionlint/cmd/actionlint@v1.7.12` from the repository root; the CI `workflows` job also runs zizmor 1.32.0 with online audits. Keep the only actionlint exception, the per-file ignore of the `queue` key diagnostic for `deploy.yml` in `.github/actionlint.yaml`, scoped to that diagnostic and file, and remove it when the pinned actionlint accepts `queue`. Suppress a zizmor finding only with an inline `# zizmor: ignore[<audit>]` comment and a comment that explains why the finding does not apply.
- Add release workflows only with an owning project contract and explicit credential boundaries.
- Keep `deploy.yml` a `workflow_dispatch`-only workflow without inputs that selects deployables from pending changesets, builds servers and binaries in parallel, deploys in dependency order, pushes the version commit and tags after every deployment and then publishes the binary releases from those tags. Do not add a second workflow that consumes changesets. Follow [the deployment workflow](../docs/repository-workflow-contract.md#deployment-workflow).
- Keep exactly three GitHub deployment environments: `static-sites` for static sites under `apps/`, `servers` for services under `servers/` and `releases` for binary releases under `cmds/` (Apple signing and the release signing key) and the release bot credentials of the `release` job. Do not add per-app, per-server, per-binary, per-stage or per-branch environments. Follow [the workflow contract](../docs/repository-workflow-contract.md#deployment-environments).
- Build jobs never reference a deployment environment or a secret. A job with a secret runs no build: it receives only build artifacts, checks them and runs repository scripts and pinned tools.
